name: Haha no Kanbyou wa Sekai Ichi!
source:
Shou is like any other boy; full of energy and loves his mom a lot.
His most recent cold doesn't seem to go away, though.

His mom wants to help, and so, based on some tips she found online, she decides to start nursing him!
Doesn't her idea of "nursing" seem a little off...?

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ375402.html]DLsite[/url]]
